purpose: Independent audit of K2 coverage lemma, K3/K5 leaf incompleteness and arc-segmentation warning

K2.argument: A nearest-neighbour diameter ball contains no third site, including in distance ties. Its Gamma2 vertex is isolated at birth; all incident three-point cofaces have strictly larger MEB radius, hence a positive-life leaf covering that point.
K2.strong_birth_property: p=0,q_min=2,shell={x,nearest}; alive and strong at K2
K2.limitation: This ensures at least one leaf incidence per point, not a statistically optimal mass choice.

K3_K5.implication: A leaf-only projection is not a complete projection onto points for K>=3; internal-branch coverage must be handled.
K3_K5.native_ID_policy: Map points by exact coordinates and compare geometric components, never raw Gamma/native node IDs.

ghost.interpretation: Small new leaf persistences do not account for a non-negligible continuation of a pre-existing internal arc if ancestors are discarded.
ghost.not_claimed: This does not refute all persistence weighting; correctly telescoping continuation segments avoids this specific double-count/loss. The three u18 scales are finite controls, not an infinite-grid limit or a whole-head stability theorem.

provenance.first_capture_gap: core/reasons.def was not in the initial .hpp-only pin.
provenance.gap_resolution: A second wrapper-only compile pins all actual project dependencies before/after and reproduces the binary used by the two saved exports bit-for-bit. No claim that the omitted initial pin existed, and no third native call.

limits: Raw-output geometric replay is autonomous in this packet; native rebuild needs the separately pinned historical library, not included.
Independent Fraction algorithms share Python Fraction, so no claim of independent arithmetic implementation.
No current R2 engine/tower/head qualification, EOM benchmark or performance/scaling qualification transferred.
No engine mutation, no GCP, only two tiny native exports.
